name: GitHub
author: EdgeSidekick
description: 搜索仓库与 Issue、阅读 PR 与代码文件、查看提交记录，并能创建 Issue 和发表评论。支持 GitHub Enterprise。

credentials.name: token
credentials.label: Personal access token
credentials.help: 建议使用 Fine-grained token，只授予需要的仓库；读 Issue/PR 需 Issues、Pull requests、Contents 的只读权限，创建 Issue/评论需对应写权限。

credentials.name: api_base
credentials.label: API 地址
credentials.help: GitHub Enterprise 填 https://你的域名/api/v3

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.label: 搜索仓库
tools.description: Search GitHub repositories with GitHub search syntax (e.g. 'fastapi language:python stars:>1000', 'org:my-org topic:cli'). Returns name, description, stars, default branch and URL.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.label: 搜索 Issue / PR
tools.description: Search issues and pull requests with GitHub search syntax, e.g. 'repo:owner/name is:open is:issue label:bug', 'is:pr author:@me is:open'. Returns number, title, state, author, labels and URL.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.label: 读取 Issue
tools.description: Read one issue or pull request conversation: body plus the latest comments.

comments.description: How many latest comments to include (default 10, max 30)

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.label: 列出 PR
tools.description: List pull requests of a repository.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.label: 读取 PR 改动
tools.description: Read a pull request: description, branches, review state and changed files with patches (truncated). Use for code review.

tools.name: get_file
tools.label: 读取文件
tools.description: Read a file (or list a directory) from a repository at a branch, tag or commit.

path.description: Path inside the repo; empty for the root directory

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA (default: the default branch)

tools.name: list_commits
tools.label: 提交记录
tools.description: List recent commits of a repository, optionally for a branch or a path.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.label: 创建 Issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a repository. Confirm title and body with the user first.

tools.name: comment_issue
tools.label: 发表评论
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue or pull request.
